metadata.name: guoapp
metadata.description: 红果鉴/真果鉴 - 专属私有短剧客户端

summary.zh: 红果鉴/真果鉴是一个基于 Flutter 的跨平台短剧客户端，支持多站源浏览、搜索、下载与播放，所有操作在设备端完成。功能涵盖追剧、批量下载、画中画、局域网互联等，覆盖 Android、Windows、iOS 平台，提供私有化影视观看体验。
summary.en: Hongguojian/Zhenguojian is a Flutter-based cross-platform short drama client that supports browsing, searching, downloading, and playback from multiple sources entirely on-device. Features include drama tracking, batch downloads, picture-in-picture, and LAN sync, covering Android, Windows, and iOS for a private video viewing experience.

metadata.name: rea
metadata.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.

summary.zh: REA 是基于 AI 智能体的自动化逆向引擎，深度解析应用行为、原生二进制及 Web 程序。它集成 Hopper、Ghidra 等工具，实现本地化深度分析，助力开发者轻松洞察并复刻复杂应用的核心技术实现。
summary.en: REA is an AI-agent-powered framework designed to automate the reverse engineering of application behaviors, native binaries, JavaScript, .NET assemblies, and websites. By integrating powerful tools like Hopper and Ghidra, it provides local, evidence-backed analysis. Developers can use REA to dissect complex app features, understand their underlying mechanics, and replicate core technologies in their own products.

metadata.name: HeinPlay
metadata.description: 海因影视，用于lunatv（moontv）的Android TV客户端，以及手机、Windows等多平台客户端，本地缓存比网页版更流畅的访问速度

summary.zh: 基于 Flutter 的跨平台影视客户端，支持 TV、手机、电脑及掌机多端同步。集成本地缓存加速、智能双网切换、多播放器后端及完善直播回放，专为大屏与掌机优化，提供流畅的影音体验。
summary.en: A cross-platform video client built with Flutter, supporting Android TV, mobile, Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck. It features local caching for smoother playback, intelligent dual-server auto-switching, multi-player backends, and comprehensive live TV catch-up, delivering an optimized big-screen entertainment experience.

metadata.name: go-music-dl
metadata.description: 一个基于 Go 语言的全网音乐搜索与下载工具。支持 CLI 命令行与 Web 服务双模式，内置网易云、QQ、酷狗、Bilibili、汽水音乐等 10+ 个主流平台，支持多源并发搜索与无损音质解析。music-dl交流群：755087923

summary.zh: 该工具基于 Go 语言实现，支持 Web、TUI 和桌面端多平台模式，聚合网易云、QQ、酷狗等十余个主流音乐平台，提供多源并发搜索、无损音质解析、本地音乐管理及歌单同步功能，适用于音乐爱好者高效搜索、试听和下载全网音乐资源。
summary.en: A Go-based tool supporting Web, TUI, and desktop modes, aggregating over 10 mainstream music platforms like NetEase and QQ, offering multi-source concurrent search, lossless audio parsing, local music management, and playlist synchronization, designed for music enthusiasts to efficiently search, preview, and download online music resources.

metadata.name: EcoHub
metadata.description: 一款高性能、现代化支持的全栈多源影视采集聚合系统，用于搭建自己的私人影视库，支持Tvbox与Ecohub原生应用

summary.zh: EcoHub是一款基于Go与Next.js的高性能自托管影视聚合系统，支持自动化多源采集与跨平台播放（TVBox、鸿蒙、安卓）。旨在帮助用户快速搭建私有影视库，提供流畅的Web与原生客户端体验。
summary.en: EcoHub is a high-performance, modern full-stack media aggregation system designed to help users easily build their private movie libraries. It features automated multi-source collection, powerful management tools, and seamless cross-platform support for TVBox and native mobile clients, ensuring smooth playback.

metadata.name: LetRecovery
metadata.description: 一款免费开源的 Windows 系统重装工具

summary.zh: LetRecovery 是一款基于 Rust 的免费开源 Windows 系统重装与维护工具，集成系统安装、备份、在线下载及工具箱。支持多格式镜像与 BitLocker 自动处理，提供桌面和 WinPE 双端操作，适用于系统崩溃恢复、驱动维护等场景，具备异步下载和无人值守部署等技术亮点。
summary.en: LetRecovery is a free, open-source Windows system reinstallation and maintenance tool built with Rust. It integrates system installation, backup, online downloads, and a toolbox. Supporting multiple image formats and automated BitLocker handling, it offers both desktop and WinPE interfaces for scenarios like system crash recovery and driver management, featuring async downloads and unattended deployment.

metadata.name: czkawka
metadata.description: Multi functional app to find duplicates, empty folders, similar images etc.

summary.zh: 基于 Rust 开发的跨平台开源文件清理工具，专注于快速查找重复文件、空文件夹、相似图片及无效链接。采用多线程高效算法，提供多端 GUI 支持，无广告、强隐私，助力磁盘空间释放。
summary.en: Czkawka is a powerful, open-source, multi-platform file cleanup utility written in Rust. It helps users quickly find duplicates, empty folders, similar images, and broken files using fast multithreaded algorithms, offering GUI and CLI frontends with strict privacy.

metadata.name: clash-verge-rev
metadata.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience

summary.zh: 基于Tauri和Rust构建的跨平台Clash GUI代理客户端，内置Clash.Meta核心，支持多系统平台。提供可视化节点规则编辑、配置同步及丰富主题定制，助力用户高效管理代理网络。
summary.en: Clash Verge Rev is a sleek, cross-platform GUI client built with Tauri and Rust, designed to deliver a tailored proxy experience. It integrates the powerful Clash.Meta kernel, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features visual node and rule editing, WebDAV config sync, TUN mode, and rich theme customization, providing a robust and user-friendly solution for proxy management.

metadata.name: gitpush
metadata.description: an AI Github Rlease Tracker Powered by Cloudflare

summary.zh: GitPush是基于Cloudflare的AI GitHub发布追踪工具。它自动监控指定仓库，利用Workers AI智能生成更新摘要，并通过邮件路由自动推送，帮助开发者高效追踪开源动态。
summary.en: GitPush is a serverless, AI-powered GitHub release tracker deployed on Cloudflare. It continuously monitors user-specified repositories, utilizes Workers AI with DeepSeek to generate concise release summaries, and automatically sends these updates to the user's inbox via Cloudflare Email Routing, offering a highly reliable workflow for developers to track open-source updates efficiently.

metadata.name: Open-Box
metadata.description: Open-Box 一体化透明代理：OpenWrt / Debian / Ubuntu / Docker；自有程序闭源，第三方组件遵守原许可。

summary.zh: Open-Box 是一体化透明代理方案，支持路由器端与多平台客户端协同。内置 sing-box 内核与完整地理数据，提供图形化面板管理订阅、分流与防火墙，无需手写配置，实现家庭内外一致的智能分流与高效网络加速。
summary.en: Open-Box is an integrated transparent proxy unifying router and multi-platform clients. It features a web panel with sing-box kernel for visual routing, subscriptions, and DNS management without manual config.

metadata.name: x-ui-pro
metadata.description: XUI-PRO nginx reverse proxy with ws/grpc/httpupgrade/splithttp,xray protocol support: vless,vmess,trojan,shadowsocks panel cloudflare ssl,xtls,ssr,v2fly,v2ray installer bypass restrictions sing-box,shadowtls,reality,tunnel,gfw tor warp wireguard geoip tuic clash vpn mihomo psiphon hy2 oneclick argo bbr wstunnel anticensorship⚡🛡️

summary.zh: XUI-PRO是一个开源代理服务器自动安装脚本，集成nginx反向代理、Xray、Warp、Tor等工具，支持vless、vmess等多种协议，提供自动SSL、多用户管理、CDN兼容及虚假页面伪装，有效绕过网络限制，适用于安全访问受限资源。
summary.en: XUI-PRO is an open-source auto-installation script for a proxy server, integrating nginx reverse proxy, Xray, Warp, Tor, and supporting multiple protocols like vless and vmess. It offers auto SSL, multi-user management, CDN compatibility, and fake page templates to bypass censorship and securely access restricted resources.

metadata.name: lx-lxwalnut-music-mobile
metadata.description: 基于lx-netease-music-mobile改版，满足个人需求，仅个人自用！！！

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 React Native 的个性化音乐播放器，支持网易云、QQ、酷狗等多平台音乐聚合。提供丰富的音质设置、主题定制、本地音乐管理及小爱音箱推送等功能，旨在为音乐爱好者提供一站式、高度可定制的移动音乐体验。
summary.en: This is a personalized music player based on React Native, supporting multi-platform music aggregation including NetEase, QQ, and KuGou. It offers rich features such as audio quality settings, theme customization, local music management, and Xiaomi speaker pushing, aiming to provide music enthusiasts with a one-stop, highly customizable mobile music experience.

metadata.name: Netcatty
metadata.description: SSH workspace, SFTP, and terminals in one

summary.zh: Netcatty 是跨平台 AI 驱动的 SSH 终端与 SFTP 管理工具。内置 AI 智能体 Catty Agent，支持自然语言服务器诊断与多主机编排，结合分屏终端与多主题，为 IT 运维提供一体化高效工作流。
summary.en: Netcatty is a powerful, cross-platform desktop application that integrates an AI-powered SSH client, SFTP browser, and advanced terminal manager into a single, cohesive workspace. Built with Electron, React, and xterm.js, its standout feature is the built-in Catty Agent, which allows IT professionals to manage servers, orchestrate multi-host tasks, diagnose system issues, and deploy complex clusters using simple natural language commands, all within a highly customizable theme environment.

metadata.name: lx-music-server
metadata.description: 运行在 Hono.js 上的 LX Music 数据同步服务，支持Cloudflare Worker部署

summary.zh: lx-music-server 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects 的 LX Music 数据同步服务，无需自托管即可实现多设备实时 WebSocket 同步。支持多用户隔离、快照合并与增量冲突处理，通过 GitHub Actions 一键部署，适用于个人音乐数据跨设备同步场景。
summary.en: lx-music-server is a LX Music data sync service built on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects, enabling real-time multi-device WebSocket sync without self-hosting. It features multi-user isolation, snapshot merging, and incremental conflict resolution, with one-click deployment via GitHub Actions for personal music data syncing.

metadata.name: lx-music-xinghai-source
metadata.description: 星海音乐源 | LX Music 自定义音源插件，聚合 GDAPI/ChKSz API，支持酷我加密音频解密（需自行配置）

summary.zh: 星海音乐源是LX Music自定义音源插件，聚合GDAPI与ChKSz接口，集成网易、QQ、酷我等五大平台。亮点是支持酷我加密音频实时解密，提供多平台无损及高音质播放，需自行部署解密服务。
summary.en: Xinghai Music Source is a custom plugin for LX Music, aggregating GDAPI and ChKSz APIs to support five major platforms. It features real-time decryption of Kuwo encrypted audio for high-quality playback, requiring self-hosted decryption configuration.

metadata.name: stremio-web
metadata.description: Stremio - Freedom to Stream

summary.zh: Stremio官方Web版媒体中心，基于React与Rust WASM内核，支持跨设备同步、Cast投屏与PWA离线播放，通过Addon发现海量影视内容，提供键盘优先与多语种支持的跨平台流媒体体验。
summary.en: Stremio-web is the official web UI for the Stremio media center, built with React and powered by a Rust WebAssembly engine. It offers seamless cross-device library synchronization, addon-based catalog discovery, casting, and keyboard controls as a PWA, delivering a powerful cross-platform streaming experience.

metadata.name: ai-coding-welfare
metadata.description: AI Coding 福利站导航：免费白嫖 Claude Code / Codex 的中转站与公益站合集，含额度、模型、价格自动更新与一键配置脚本

summary.zh: 这是一个 AI 编码福利站导航，聚合了多个免费提供 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的中转站与公益站。通过自动化脚本和实时数据更新，帮助开发者快速获取免费额度，降低 AI 编码成本，提升效率。适用于需要低成本使用 AI 大模型的开发者。
summary.en: This is an AI coding welfare station directory aggregating multiple transit and public stations offering free AI coding tools like Claude Code and Codex. Through automation scripts and real-time updates, it helps developers quickly obtain free credits, reducing AI coding costs and boosting efficiency. Ideal for developers needing low-cost AI large language model access.

metadata.name: LinkSwift
metadata.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘

summary.zh: LinkSwift 是一款基于 JavaScript 的多网盘直链提取工具，支持百度、阿里云等八大主流网盘。它通过脚本技术自动解析页面，帮助用户快速获取文件真实下载地址，极大提升下载效率与便捷性。
summary.en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based tool designed to extract direct download links from eight major cloud drives, including Baidu and Aliyun. It automates link parsing on web pages, offering users a seamless and efficient way to grab direct file URLs.

metadata.name: FluxDown
metadata.description: Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，智能多线程加速与浏览器无缝集成。精美界面，极致性能，永久免费，零广告。

summary.zh: 基于 Rust+Tokio 内核的跨平台多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP、BT 磁力及 HLS/DASH 流媒体。集成智能分段加速、浏览器插件与 AI 智能体 MCP 协议，实现本地优先、零广告的极致下载体验。
summary.en: FluxDown is a blazing-fast, cross-platform, Rust-driven multi-protocol download manager designed as a free, open-source alternative to commercial tools like IDM. It natively supports HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent magnet links, and HLS/DASH streaming across desktop, mobile, and web platforms. Powered by the high-performance Tokio engine and GPUI, it features smart dynamic segmentation, browser interception, and an integrated MCP server for AI-agent automation, ensuring a local-first, ad-free experience.

metadata.name: hsck
metadata.description: hsck json

summary.zh: hsck 是一款海阔小程序离线数据源采集工具，自动抓取视频数据并生成 JSON、M3U 等格式的离线文件。支持缓存去重与微信推送，结合 GitHub Actions 可实现定时自动化采集与更新。
summary.en: hsck is an offline data source collection tool for the Haikuo mini-program, automatically scraping video data to generate JSON, TXT, and M3U files. It features cache deduplication, WeChat notifications, and scheduled automation via GitHub Actions.

metadata.name: fapiao-print
metadata.description: 发票酱 - 发票批量打印工具，轻量桌面应用+WEB模式，支持 PDF、OFD、XML、图片等多格式，一键识别发票数据，快速排版、打印、重命名或导出

summary.zh: 发票酱是一款面向财务场景的轻量级发票批量打印工具，支持PDF、OFD、XML及图片等多格式。集成PP-OCRv6智能识别与原生OFD渲染，实现发票信息自动提取、智能排版、批量打印、重命名与去重，显著提升发票处理效率。
summary.en: Fapiao Print is a lightweight invoice batch printing tool designed for finance departments, supporting PDF, OFD, XML, and images. With built-in PP-OCRv6 and native OFD rendering, it automatically extracts invoice data, enabling smart layout, batch printing, renaming, and deduplication, significantly improving invoice processing efficiency.

metadata.name: edgeever
metadata.description: AI-native knowledge base & Evernote/Obsidian alternative with instant sync & native MCP. Free on Cloudflare or self-hosted via Docker.

summary.zh: EdgeEver 是一款 AI 原生知识库与笔记应用，提供经典的高效三栏工作流与即时同步功能。它支持原生 MCP 与 AI 智能体集成，可免费运行于 Cloudflare 或通过 Docker 自托管，保障数据私有与高效协同。
summary.en: EdgeEver is an AI-native knowledge base and a modern alternative to Evernote and Obsidian. It features a classic three-pane workflow, instant sync, and native MCP support. Users can enjoy free, serverless deployment on Cloudflare or self-host via Docker for complete data ownership.

metadata.name: cf-manager
metadata.description: An all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare. Manage Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference & browser rendering visually, with an OpenAI-compatible API for external integration.

summary.zh: CF Manager 是自托管的 Cloudflare 多账户统一管理平台，可视化操作 Workers、DNS、存储及 AI 推理，内置 OpenAI 兼容 API 用于本地调试，解决多账户切换与批量资源管理的痛点。
summary.en: CF Manager is a self-hosted, all-in-one dashboard for Cloudflare that unifies multi-account management of Workers, DNS, storage, AI inference, and browser rendering. It features visual batch operations, real-time quota monitoring, and an OpenAI-compatible API for local debugging, eliminating the need for constant account switching.

metadata.name: Median
metadata.description: 一个功能密度极高的，安装包仅200kb的极致轻量化浏览器

summary.zh: Median是一款仅200kb的极致轻量Android隐私浏览器，基于系统WebView与原生Java开发。集成广告拦截、本地加密密码库、用户脚本及离线阅读，零遥测、零广告，重塑本地隐私安全浏览新体验。
summary.en: Median is an extremely lightweight, 200KB local-first Android privacy browser engineered with native Java and the system WebView. It integrates powerful features like ad blocking, an encrypted local password vault, user script execution, and offline MHTML reading. Offering zero telemetry and no ads, it provides a highly secure, private, and smooth browsing experience for Android users.

metadata.name: otter-music
metadata.description: 基于 React + Capacitor 的免费音乐 App，支持多音源搜索、网易云登录、主流平台歌单导入，以及 B 站音源搜索播放，安装包仅 2.5 MB。基于 GD Studio's Online Music Platform API。

summary.zh: 基于 React 与 Capacitor 的免费跨平台音乐播放器，体积仅 2.5 MB。聚合多主流音源支持智能回退与歌单导入，通过 PWA 提供接近原生的移动端体验，实现极致轻量化的多源音乐播放与数据同步。
summary.en: Otter Music is a free, incredibly lightweight cross-platform music player built with React and Capacitor, weighing just 2.5 MB. It aggregates diverse sources like NetEase, QQ, and Bilibili, supporting multi-source search, smart playlist import, smart audio source fallback, and WebDAV data backup. Delivering a near-native mobile experience via PWA, it offers a comprehensive, high-quality, and highly efficient music playback solution for web and mobile platforms.

metadata.name: ziyuanzhan
metadata.description: 资源站,影视资源站与采集站聚集和收集平台。实时监控全网主流影视类、视频类采集联盟的播放源、视频源接口可用性支持libretv，moontvplus，maccms等

summary.zh: 本项目通过GitHub Actions定时采集全网影视资源站数据，使用Python进行健康检查，生成静态JSON和HTML页面，实现零成本实时监控资源站可用性，支持多种接口协议，为AI Agent提供数据接口。
summary.en: This project uses GitHub Actions to periodically collect data from media resource sites, performs health checks with Python, and generates static JSON and HTML pages. It enables zero-cost real-time monitoring of resource site availability, supports multiple protocols, and provides data interfaces for AI Agents.

metadata.name: awesome-zhuiju-free
metadata.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。

summary.zh: 这是一个免费无广告的追剧资源指南，通过人工精选和每日自动化检测确保资源有效性。收录在线影视、APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox配置、IPTV直播源等多元内容，完全开源并由社区共同维护，适合追剧爱好者快速获取可靠资源。
summary.en: This is a free, ad-free guide to drama resources, featuring manually curated selections and daily automated checks for resource validity. It covers online videos, apps, cloud storage searches, magnet BT, subtitles, TVBox configurations, IPTV live sources, and more. Open-source and community-maintained, it's ideal for drama enthusiasts seeking reliable resources.

metadata.name: CoShell
metadata.description: 一款集成 AI 助手的轻量级 SSH 终端桌面应用。

summary.zh: CoShell 是一款本地优先、集成 AI Agent 的轻量级桌面 SSH/SFTP 工作台。它融合多标签终端、文件管理与本地安全加密，无需外部 CDN 或 Docker 依赖，面向个人开发者与运维人员，提供安全、高效的一站式智能运维与远程管理体验。
summary.en: CoShell is a local-first, lightweight desktop SSH and SFTP workstation integrated with an AI Agent. Combining multi-tab terminals, secure file management, and local search, it operates entirely without external dependencies, offering developers and administrators a secure, efficient, and smart one-stop solution for remote server operations.

metadata.name: LunaTV-config
metadata.description: MoonTV/LunaTV源配置，每日自动检测API状态，可在CF部署CORSAPI中转被墙API，本人提供的CORSAPI仅为测试使用，请勿滥用！

summary.zh: 本项目提供MoonTV/LunaTV配置编辑器，核心功能包括每日自动检测API状态及通过Cloudflare Workers部署CORSAPI代理被墙API。支持多种配置源与Base58编码格式，适用于流媒体服务的网络访问优化与API中转管理。
summary.en: This repository offers a configuration editor for MoonTV/LunaTV, featuring daily automated API status detection and CORSAPI deployment via Cloudflare Workers to proxy blocked APIs. It supports multiple configuration sources and Base58 encoding, facilitating network optimization and API relay for streaming services.

metadata.name: sublinkPro
metadata.description: ✨ 现代化代理订阅管理平台 | 智能分类 · 专业测速 · 链式中转 · 流量监控 · TG管理 · JS扩展 | Go+React 全新UI 🌍 Modern Proxy Subscription Manager | Smart Tags · Speed Test · Relays · Monitor · TG Bot · JS Scripts

summary.zh: SublinkPro是一个基于Go和React的现代化代理订阅管理平台，提供智能标签分类、专业测速、链式中转、流量监控、Telegram机器人管理和JS脚本扩展功能。适用于个人和企业网络优化，技术栈包括Gin、Gorm、MUI和Vite，支持Docker部署，确保安全高效的代理管理。
summary.en: SublinkPro is a modern proxy subscription management platform built with Go and React, featuring smart tagging, speed testing, relay chains, traffic monitoring, Telegram bot integration, and JS script extensions. Designed for personal and enterprise network optimization, it utilizes a tech stack of Gin, Gorm, MUI, and Vite, with Docker support for efficient and secure deployment.

metadata.name: NetQuality
metadata.description: 网络质量检测脚本 - Network Quality Check Script

summary.zh: NetQuality脚本提供全面网络质量检测，集成BGP信息、三网延迟测试、Speedtest测速及完整路由追踪等七大模块。支持IPv4/IPv6双栈与跨平台运行，输出精美直观且兼容JSON，便于结果分享与大数据分析，适用于网络运维、故障排查与性能评估。
summary.en: NetQuality is a comprehensive network quality check script featuring seven modules, including BGP info, triple-network latency tests, Speedtest, and full route tracing. It supports IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack and cross-platform execution, delivering visually appealing output and JSON format for data analysis, ideal for network operations, troubleshooting, and performance evaluation.

metadata.name: sms_forwarding
metadata.description: 超低成本硬件短信转发器，支持移动联通电信，ML307R+ESP32C3

summary.zh: 本项目基于ESP32C3和ML307R 4G模块，实现超低成本硬件短信转发器，支持移动、联通、电信卡。通过Web界面配置，可同时启用5个推送通道（如HTTP、Bark、钉钉等），适用于短信接收与保号场景，具备长短信合并、管理员远程控制等亮点。
summary.en: This project implements an ultra-low-cost hardware SMS forwarder using ESP32C3 and ML307R 4G module. It supports China Mobile, Unicom, and Telecom cards, with a Web interface for configuration. It can enable up to 5 push channels simultaneously (e.g., HTTP, Bark, DingTalk), suitable for SMS receiving and number maintenance, featuring long SMS merging and remote admin control.

summary.zh: 3X-UI是基于Xray-core的Web控制面板，用于配置和管理VPN/代理协议。作为二次开发分支，它内置一键协议模板、中转、多服务器下发、批量管理等功能，支持扫码导入和共享订阅，界面中文化，旨在让协议搭建点几下即可完成。
summary.en: 3X-UI is a web-based control panel for Xray-core, used to configure and monitor various VPN/agent protocols. As a fork of MHSanaei/3x-ui, it features one-click protocol templates, relay, multi-server deployment, batch management, QR code import, and shared subscriptions. The interface is localized in Chinese, aiming to simplify protocol setup.

metadata.name: GithubStarsIndex
metadata.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。

summary.zh: 自动抓取GitHub Stars，调用AI生成智能摘要与标准化标签。内置纯规则“Stars Atlas”网格实现多维分面检索，并提供静态API与MCP服务，方便Agent调用及Obsidian同步，构建高效个人知识库。
summary.en: Automatically fetch GitHub Stars, leverage AI to generate smart summaries and normalized tags. Features the rule-based "Stars Atlas" grid for multi-dimensional faceted search, exposing static APIs and an MCP server for Agent integration, while offering seamless Obsidian sync to build a highly searchable personal knowledge base.

metadata.name: Selene-TV
metadata.description: 以 MoonTV v100 版本 / Helios 为后端的 Android TV 客户端，针对遥控器设备优化

summary.zh: Selene-TV是一款基于MoonTV/Helios后端的Android TV客户端，采用Kotlin与Jetpack Compose for TV构建，支持ExoPlayer/mpv双内核播放。应用针对遥控器深度优化，提供多源聚合、智能选源、多平台弹幕、扫码遥控及直播等功能，适配大屏沉浸式体验。
summary.en: Selene-TV is an Android TV client built on MoonTV/Helios backend, leveraging Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for TV with dual playback cores (ExoPlayer/mpv). Optimized for remote controls, it offers multi-source aggregation, smart stream selection, multi-platform danmaku, phone remote control, and live TV, delivering an immersive big-screen experience.

metadata.description: nine one

summary.zh: 个人私有视频站，支持多网盘低带宽302播放、短视频沉浸模式、一次性分享及TG机器人接入，可通过爬虫脚本扩展，快速部署专属私人影院。
summary.en: A powerful personal private video website supporting multi-cloud storage with low-bandwidth 302 redirects, short video mode, one-time sharing, Telegram bot integration, and custom crawler scripts for building a private cinema.

metadata.name: vpn-configs-for-russia
metadata.description: 🗽Бесплатные и проверенные VPN/Tor конфигурации, работающие в РФ ⚪ Белые списки / обход белых списков ⚪ Free and checked VPN/Tor configurations that work in Russia ⚪ Whitelists bypass

summary.zh: 该仓库收集并自动测试免费VPN/Tor配置，针对俄罗斯网络环境优化，支持VLESS、Trojan、Shadowsocks等多种协议。通过自动化脚本在俄罗斯服务器上频繁测试可用性、延迟和速度，剔除无效配置，确保用户获取最新、稳定的绕过审查的连接方案，有效应对网络封锁。
summary.en: This repository collects and automatically tests free VPN/Tor configurations optimized for the Russian network environment, supporting protocols like VLESS, Trojan, Shadowsocks, and more. Automated scripts run frequent tests on Russian servers to check availability, latency, and speed, filtering out working configs to ensure users get fresh, reliable circumvention tools to bypass censorship and stay online.

summary.zh: 本项目是一个基于Cloudflare Workers、D1和R2构建的轻量级博客系统，具有高性能、易部署的特点。适用于个人和企业快速搭建博客平台。技术亮点包括边缘计算架构、分布式数据库和对象存储，支持MCP协议对接AI agent，并提供丰富的功能如表情包、版权模块、广告模块和SEO优化，助力用户高效管理内容。
summary.en: This project is a lightweight blog system built on Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2, offering high performance and easy deployment. It is suitable for individuals and enterprises to quickly set up blog platforms. Technical highlights include edge computing architecture, distributed database, and object storage, with support for MCP protocol to integrate AI agents. It provides rich features such as emojis, copyright modules, ad modules, and SEO optimization, enabling efficient content management.

summary.zh: X-Spider修改版是一款功能强大的推特（X）媒体批量下载工具，支持图片与视频抓取。核心特性包括批量添加博主、一键去重下载、自定义日期范围与保存路径，配备Cookie登录及代理支持，旨在实现高效、自动化的社交媒体资源归档。
summary.en: X-Spider modified version is a powerful Twitter (X) media downloader designed for batch capturing images and videos. It features batch blogger addition, one-click downloading with deduplication, customizable date filters, and path formats. Equipped with cookie login and proxy support, it ensures efficient, automated archiving of social media content.

metadata.name: streambert
metadata.description: A cross-platform Electron Desktop App to stream and download any Movie, TV Series or Anime in the World. Zero Ads and Tracking

summary.zh: Streambert是一款跨平台Electron桌面应用，专注提供无广告追踪的全球影视动漫流媒体播放与多线程高速下载。整合TMDB与AniList，支持字幕下载、本地库管理及深度界面自定义，打造隐私安全的个人影音中心。
summary.en: Cross-platform Electron desktop app for streaming and downloading movies, TV series, and anime with zero ads and tracking. Features fast downloads, subtitle support, and a customizable library, integrating TMDB and AniList.

summary.zh: 本项目基于Cloudflare Workers提供零配置部署方案，实现体育赛事直播源的自动化订阅生成与授权码访问控制，支持TXT/M3U双格式输出，兼顾快速部署与跨平台兼容性，适用于个人快速搭建自定义直播列表。
summary.en: This project leverages Cloudflare Workers for zero-config deployment, enabling automated generation of sports live streaming subscriptions with authorization code access control. It supports dual TXT/M3U formats and cross-platform compatibility, ideal for rapid personal custom streaming list setup.

metadata.name: K-Vault
metadata.description: 基于 Cloudflare 的 Serverless 聚合云盘。以 Telegram 为核心（支持 Webhook 直传与 2GB 扩展），并全面兼容 R2、S3、Discord 及 HuggingFace 等多存储后端。零成本构建你的全能私有数据金库。

summary.zh: 基于 Cloudflare 的无服务器聚合云存储方案。以 Telegram 为核心，兼容 R2、S3、Discord 等多后端，支持 Pages 与 Docker 双模零成本部署，提供 API、WebDAV 及丰富管理功能，助您构建私有全能数据金库。
summary.en: K-Vault is a serverless, aggregated cloud storage platform built on Cloudflare. Leveraging Telegram as its core engine, it seamlessly integrates major backends like R2, S3, Discord, and HuggingFace. Supporting both Pages and Docker deployments, it offers zero-cost, secure, and programmable file management via API and WebDAV to build your ultimate private data vault.

metadata.name: lxserver
metadata.description: LX Music 数据同步服务端，同时支持了部分lx-music-desktop的网页端实现。

summary.zh: LX Music增强版数据同步服务端，集成Web音乐播放器，支持多源搜索、本地曲库管理、多平台歌单同步与个性化定制，实现浏览器端高效音乐播放与数据无缝同步。
summary.en: An enhanced LX Music data synchronization server featuring a built-in web player. It supports multi-source aggregation search, local music library management, multi-platform playlist synchronization, and personalized themes, providing seamless browser-based playback and robust data syncing capabilities.

metadata.name: Telegram_MistRelay
metadata.description: MistRelay MistRelay 是一个基于 Telegram Bot 的高性能 aria2 下载控制、Telegram 频道网盘中继与媒体流分发系统。系统将 HTTP/磁力/种子下载、Telegram 频道无限云存储、多机器人免加频道负载均衡集群、@BotFather 自动化扩容流水线、后台缩略图静默预热引擎、统一缓存生命周期治理中心以及现代毛玻璃 Web 管理中台整合至单个安全加固的 Docker 容器中。                                     官网：https://mistrelay.jiuyue520.com/

summary.zh: MistRelay v3.0 是企业级多租户 Telegram 无限云盘与边缘流媒体分发中台，整合 Aria2 智能下载、多机器人集群、边缘 VPS 推流及 AI 客服，于安全加固 Docker 容器内实现物理隔离存储与高效全球分发。
summary.en: Enterprise Telegram cloud storage and edge streaming platform, integrating Aria2 downloads, multi-bot clustering, and edge VPS streaming in a hardened Docker container.
tags_zh: 多租户云存储与边缘流媒体

metadata.name: Agent-Reach
metadata.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.

summary.zh: Agent Reach 是专为 AI Agent 设计的互联网信息获取工具，通过简洁的 CLI 命令，集成 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台的读取与搜索能力，无需付费 API 和复杂配置，有效解决 Agent 上网的信息盲区，让智能体一键具备全网感知能力。
summary.en: Agent Reach is an internet information retrieval tool designed for AI agents. With a simple CLI command, it integrates reading and searching capabilities across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu, eliminating the need for paid APIs and complex configuration. It effectively addresses the information blind spots of agents online, enabling smart agents to instantly gain full internet awareness.

metadata.name: warden-worker
metadata.description: A Bitwarden-compatible server for Cloudflare Workers

summary.zh: Warden 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Bitwarden 兼容服务器，提供免费、自托管且低维护的密码管理方案。它利用无服务器架构和 D1 数据库，支持核心 vault 操作、文件附件、TOTP 及实时同步，适用于个人用户避免服务器管理负担。
summary.en: Warden is a Bitwarden-compatible server built on Cloudflare Workers, offering a free, self-hosted, and low-maintenance password management solution. It leverages serverless architecture and D1 database to support core vault operations, file attachments, TOTP, and real-time sync, ideal for personal use without server management hassles.

metadata.name: nodewarden
metadata.description: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers

summary.zh: NodeWarden 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Bitwarden 兼容自托管服务器，支持离线、Passkey、多用户与云端备份，利用边缘计算实现安全、实时同步的密码管理解决方案。
summary.en: NodeWarden is a Bitwarden-compatible server on Cloudflare Workers, featuring PWA offline, Passkey, multi-user sync, and cloud backup, leveraging edge computing for secure self-hosted password management.

summary.zh: 该OpenWRT插件集成多种消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信等平台，用于路由器设备状态监控和自动化通知，具备在线检测、流量统计等功能，有效提升网络运维效率。
summary.en: This OpenWRT plugin integrates multiple push services for router device monitoring and automated notifications, supporting platforms like DingTalk and WeCom, with features such as online detection and traffic statistics to enhance network management efficiency.

metadata.name: movecar
metadata.description: 🚗 智能挪车通知系统 - 基于 Cloudflare Workers，支持实时位置共享和多推送服务

summary.zh: MoveCar 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的智能挪车通知系统，通过扫码联系车主保护隐私，支持双向实时位置共享与防骚扰机制，借助 Serverless 架构实现免费部署与零运维。
summary.en: MoveCar is a Cloudflare Workers-based smart car move notification system that enables QR code scanning to contact owners without exposing phone numbers. It features bidirectional real-time location sharing, anti-harassment mechanisms, and leverages serverless architecture for free deployment and zero maintenance.

metadata.name: videoduplicatefinder
metadata.description: Video Duplicate Finder - Crossplatform

summary.zh: Video Duplicate Finder 是一款跨平台视频去重工具，支持检测不同分辨率、帧率及水印的相似视频。结合音频指纹与AI（DINOv2）技术，可识别部分片段和编辑副本，提供GUI、CLI、Web UI及Docker部署，适用于个人与NAS环境。
summary.en: Video Duplicate Finder is a cross-platform tool for detecting duplicate videos with varying resolutions, frame rates, and watermarks. It uses audio fingerprinting and AI (DINOv2) to identify partial clips and edited copies, offering GUI, CLI, Web UI, and Docker for personal and NAS use.

metadata.name: MoonTVPlus
metadata.description: MoonTVPlus 是基于 MoonTV v100 二次开发的增强版影视聚合播放器。它在原版基础上新增了外部播放器支持、视频超分、弹幕系统、评论抓取等实用功能，提供更强大的观影体验。

summary.en: Generation failed

summary.zh: 基于LuatOS的智能短信转发系统，支持关键词和正则表达式匹配，可将短信并发转发至企业微信、飞书、钉钉等多渠道。具备异步处理、容错恢复和低功耗特性，适用于IoT设备如Air780E的短信通知自动化。
summary.en: An intelligent SMS forwarding system based on LuatOS, designed for IoT devices like Air780E. It supports keyword matching (case-insensitive) and Lua regular expression matching, enabling flexible message filtering. The system can forward SMS to multiple channels including enterprise WeChat (WeCom), Feishu, DingTalk, custom webhooks, and email, with concurrent asynchronous processing for high reliability. Additional features include automatic device info appending, network fault recovery, low power consumption with periodic memory recycling, and watchdog protection. Ideal for automating SMS notifications in IoT applications.

metadata.name: renewhelper
metadata.description: RenewHelper - 时序·守望是一款基于Cloudflare Workers的全栈服务生命周期提醒、管理工具。它专为管理周期性订阅、域名续费、服务器到期等场景设计。无需服务器，零成本托管，提供精美的机甲风（Mecha-style）UI 界面、强大的农历/公历计算核心、多渠道通知推送能力、iCal日程同步以及账单管理功能。同时支持Worker和Docker方式部署。

summary.zh: RenewHelper是一款基于Cloudflare Workers的零成本服务生命周期管理工具，支持公历与农历周期计算，提供多渠道通知、iCal同步及账单管理功能。其机甲风UI与双部署模式（Worker/Docker）兼顾美观与灵活性，适用于个人及企业订阅、域名续费等场景。
summary.en: RenewHelper is a zero-cost service lifecycle management tool built on Cloudflare Workers. It supports both Gregorian and lunar calendar calculations, offering multi-channel notifications, iCal sync, and billing management. With a mecha-style UI and dual deployment options (Worker/Docker), it's ideal for managing subscriptions, domain renewals, and more.

metadata.name: dysync.net
metadata.description: 视频同步工具

summary.zh: dysync.net 是一款基于 .NET Core 和 Vue 的抖音视频同步工具，支持自动抓取收藏夹、喜欢视频及博主作品，内置刮削功能，可无缝对接 Emby/Jellyfin 媒体库。其跨平台 Docker 部署、多账号管理与扩展存储设计，极大简化了视频备份与整理流程，适合个人用户构建专属视频库。
summary.en: dysync.net is a Douyin video synchronization tool developed with .NET Core and Vue. It enables automatic syncing of favorited videos and specified creators' works, featuring built-in metadata scraping and seamless integration with Emby or Jellyfin media servers. Supporting multi-account management, cross-platform Docker deployment, and extensible storage, it simplifies video backup and organization, making it ideal for users to build and manage their personal video libraries.

metadata.name: go-wxpush
metadata.description: 极简且免费的微信消息推送服务 (基于golang)

summary.zh: 该仓库提供了一个基于Golang的免费微信消息推送服务，通过简单的HTTP API接口实现消息发送。支持Docker一键部署，每天10万次免费额度，具备微信原生弹窗提醒和多用户支持，适用于个人或企业快速集成微信通知场景。
summary.en: This repository offers a free WeChat message pushing service based on Golang, enabling message delivery via a simple HTTP API interface. It supports one-click Docker deployment, provides 100,000 daily free pushes, features native WeChat pop-up reminders, and allows multi-user support, suitable for individuals or businesses needing quick integration of WeChat notifications.

metadata.name: uart_sms_forwarder
metadata.description: Air780 短信UART转发器

summary.zh: 基于合宙Air780的短信UART转发工具，通过串口将短信实时同步至Linux主机。支持短信收发、记录管理、多渠道Webhook通知及计划任务，适用于IoT设备短信自动化接收与运维告警。
summary.en: A UART-based SMS forwarding system for Air780 modules, forwarding messages to a host computer in real-time. It features comprehensive SMS logging, call alerts, scheduled sends, and multi-channel webhook notifications, ideal for IoT automation and system alerting.

metadata.name: argosbx
metadata.description: 小白自建代理神器！ArgoSBX一键无交互小钢炮脚本💣：Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核自动搭配；支持VPS、Docker、容器多环境部署；套CDN的5大方案+套WARP的15种组合；已支持协议：Naiveproxy、AnyTLS、Any-reality、Vless-xhttp-reality-vision-enc、Vless-tcp-reality-vision、Vless-xhttp-vision-enc、Vless-ws-vision-enc、Shadowsocks-2022、Hysteria2、Tuic、Socks5、Vmess-ws、Argo临时/固定隧道

summary.zh: Argosbx是一键无交互自建代理小钢炮脚本，集成Sing-box、Xray和Argo三内核，支持VPS与Docker多环境部署。提供15种WARP出站组合与5套CDN优选方案，无需域名即可快速搭建抗封锁、多协议（如Hysteria2、Tuic、Vless等）的高效代理节点。
summary.en: Argosbx is a one-click, non-interactive proxy setup script integrating Sing-box, Xray, and Argo kernels. It supports multi-environment deployment on VPS and Docker, offering 15 WARP outbound combinations and 5 CDN nesting solutions to bypass IP blocking. It enables rapid deployment of multi-protocol, high-performance proxy nodes without requiring a domain.

metadata.name: XHTTP-Installer
metadata.description: VLESS+XHTTP+TLS Auto-Installer for Ubuntu — Vercel / Netlify relay

summary.zh: 一键自动化部署VLESS+XHTTP+TLS代理服务器脚本，适用于Ubuntu。通过Vercel或Netlify CDN中继隐藏真实IP，结合自动TLS配置，实现低成本、高隐匿的流量伪装与网络突破。
summary.en: This script provides one-click automated deployment of a VLESS+XHTTP+TLS proxy server on Ubuntu. By leveraging Vercel or Netlify as a CDN relay, it effectively hides the server's real IP address. With automatic TLS certificate issuance, it offers a free, high-speed, and highly secure solution for traffic camouflage and network censorship circumvention.

summary.zh: CFnew 是超轻量级 Cloudflare 边缘代理内核，体积仅37KB，将核心转发留在云端，管理与订阅交由独立面板。支持 VLESS、Trojan 协议，实现极致性能与便捷的节点优选管理。
summary.en: CFnew is an ultra-lightweight proxy kernel designed for Cloudflare Workers, reducing core size to just 37KB. It handles traffic forwarding on the edge, while offloading node optimization, configuration, and subscription generation to a separate panel, supporting VLESS and Trojan protocols.

summary.zh: MageKit 是基于 Rust 和 GPUI 的跨平台桌面媒体工具，集成视频下载、网页媒体捕获与直播录制。它深度整合 yt-dlp、FFmpeg 与 Streamlink，提供高效的队列管理与工具配置，支持多语言与深色模式。
summary.en: MageKit is a powerful, cross-platform native desktop media toolkit built with Rust and GPUI, integrating video downloads, webpage media capture, and live stream recording. It deeply integrates core tools like yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and Streamlink, offering efficient task queue management, comprehensive tool configuration, and multi-language theme support for a seamless media workflow.

metadata.name: TVAPP
metadata.description: 收集全网 Android TV电视盒子应用，涵盖影视、直播、K歌、工具、游戏等类型，整理优质APK资源，支持便捷下载与自动更新。提供安全验证、分类索引与兼容性标注，助力用户打造家庭影音娱乐中心！              ✅ TVBox/影视仓等影音壳接口配置源。

summary.zh: 仓库聚合全网Android TV盒子应用，涵盖影视、直播、游戏及工具。提供便捷下载、自动更新与兼容性标注，集成TVBox、影视仓等主流接口配置源，助力用户轻松打造家庭影音娱乐中心。
summary.en: A curated collection of premium Android TV applications for movies, live TV, games, and utilities. It offers direct downloads, auto-update checks, and detailed compatibility notes, along with configuration sources for TVBox and other popular streaming shells, helping users easily build a powerful home entertainment hub.

metadata.name: trackerslist
metadata.description: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers

summary.zh: 提供每日自动更新的公共BitTorrent Tracker多协议及IP列表，专为BT客户端设计，用于增强种子peer连接、加速冷门资源下载，是提升P2P共享效率的实用工具。
summary.en: Provides daily automatically updated public BitTorrent tracker lists, supporting multiple protocols like UDP, HTTPS, I2P, and IP formats. Designed for P2P users to enhance peer connectivity, improve download stability, and revive rare torrent sharing.

metadata.name: whistle
metadata.description: HTTP, HTTP2, HTTPS, Websocket debugging proxy

summary.zh: whistle 是基于 Node.js 的跨平台网络抓包与调试代理工具，支持 HTTP、HTTPS 及 WebSocket 协议的抓包与流量修改。它通过规则配置和可视化界面，提供一站式网络调试与插件扩展，助力高效开发。
summary.en: Whistle is a cross-platform, Node.js-based network debugging proxy for capturing and modifying HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, and WebSocket traffic. It features a powerful rule engine, a unified web interface, and plugin extensibility, streamlining network debugging across desktop and server environments.

metadata.name: bilibili-video-downloader
metadata.description: 哔哩哔哩 bilibili B站 视频 下载器，图形界面 + nfo刮削 + 广告标记 + 字幕下载 + 弹幕下载，轻松将视频加入emby等媒体库

summary.zh: 基于Tauri v2的跨平台哔哩哔哩视频下载工具，支持全类型视频、高清画质与音频下载。集成NFO刮削、字幕弹幕获取及广告标记，自动化整理媒体库，轻松无缝接入Emby等主流媒体服务器。
summary.en: A powerful, cross-platform Bilibili video downloader featuring a modern Tauri v2 GUI. It supports high-quality downloads, automatic NFO scraping, subtitle and danmaku fetching, and ad chapter marking, making it effortless to build a personalized Emby media library.

metadata.name: GitHubDaily
metadata.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.

summary.zh: GitHubDaily 是一个持续更新的 GitHub 开源项目推荐平台，涵盖 AI 工具、开发工具、学习教程等多领域，帮助开发者发现高质量项目、掌握技术动态，提升编程能力。自 2015 年起已分享超万个项目，是开发者拓展技术视野的实用指南。
summary.en: GitHubDaily is a curated platform that shares high-quality, interesting open-source projects from GitHub, including AI tools, developer tools, programming websites, and tech news. It aims to help developers discover top projects, track tech trends, and learn from source code. Active since 2015, it has shared over 10,000 projects across multiple social media platforms.

metadata.name: free-proxy-list
metadata.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)

summary.zh: Proxifly提供全球免费代理列表，每5分钟更新，涵盖HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4和SOCKS5协议，来自145个国家。支持JSON、TXT、CSV格式及NPM模块编程访问。适用于网页爬虫、自动化工具和数据采集，帮助隐藏IP或突破地域限制，提升网络操作的灵活性和安全性。
summary.en: Proxifly offers a free proxy list with over 78,000 proxies from 145 countries, covering HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 protocols. Updated every 5 minutes, it provides data in JSON, TXT, and CSV formats, along with an NPM module for programmatic access. Ideal for web scraping, automation, and bypassing geo-restrictions, ensuring high availability and easy integration.

metadata.name: BiliTools
metadata.description: 本项目已停止维护。

summary.zh: BiliTools是一款针对哔哩哔哩平台的工具项目，因收到平台方指控侵权与不正当竞争的法律函件，已于2026年7月起正式停止维护与所有版本更新，不再提供后续服务，仅保留历史记录供用户参考。
summary.en: BiliTools is a utility toolkit for the Bilibili platform. It has officially ceased all development, updates, and community support as of July 2026, following a legal letter alleging infringement and unfair competition, leaving only a historical record of the tool.

metadata.name: chinese-independent-developer
metadata.description: 👩🏿‍💻👨🏾‍💻👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻👩🏻‍💻中国独立开发者项目列表 -- 分享大家都在做什么

summary.zh: 本仓库系统整理了中国独立开发者的各类项目，包括AI应用、语音工具、桌面软件、在线工具和游戏等，全面展示开发者的创意与技术能力。仓库旨在提供一个项目发现与分享的平台，促进开发者之间的交流与合作，推动独立开发生态的繁荣。
summary.en: This repository systematically organizes various projects from independent Chinese developers, including AI applications, voice tools, desktop software, online tools, and games, fully demonstrating developers' creativity and technical skills. The repository aims to provide a platform for project discovery and sharing, fostering exchange and collaboration among developers, and promoting the prosperity of the independent development ecosystem.

metadata.name: pansou
metadata.description: PanSou是一款高性能的网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件搜索。系统设计以性能和可扩展性为核心，支持多频道多插件并发搜索、结果智能排序和网盘类型分类。docker集成前后端，一键启动，开箱即用。仅供学习研究，请勿以各种形式用于盈利目的。 https://t.me/s/webhtv

summary.zh: PanSou是一款高性能网盘搜索API，支持并发TG频道与异步插件。集成智能排序、网盘分类与二级缓存，Docker一键部署，开箱即用，专为高效资源检索与学习研究设计。
summary.en: PanSou is a high-performance cloud storage search API service, supporting concurrent Telegram channel searches and async plugins. It features intelligent sorting, multi-cloud classification, and dual-level caching, offering a dockerized, one-click solution for resource aggregation and learning purposes.

metadata.name: go-rename
metadata.description: go-rename 照片视频重命名工具 支持Windows/MacOS/Linux等各平台

summary.zh: go-rename 是一款基于 Golang 开发的跨平台照片与视频重命名工具。它支持根据 EXIF 拍摄时间或文件属性进行智能排序，采用 IMG_/VID_ 标准格式命名，并支持 MD5 去重，有效解决相机与手机照片整理混乱的痛点。
summary.en: go-rename is a robust, cross-platform tool built in Golang for renaming photos and videos. It intelligently extracts EXIF shooting times or uses file metadata to apply standard IMG_ and VID_ naming conventions, featuring MD5 deduplication to efficiently organize massive photo libraries.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供了基于Java的斐讯R1音箱物联网解决方案，通过Docker容器化实现快速部署与管理。支持网络主机模式，简化网络配置，适用于智能家居设备控制与自动化场景。技术亮点包括Java开发、Docker编排及高效集成能力。
summary.en: This repository provides a Java-based IoT solution for the Phicomm R1 speaker, leveraging Docker for containerized deployment and management. It supports host network mode for easy configuration, targeting smart home device control and automation. Key features include Java development, Docker orchestration, and efficient integration.

metadata.name: OpenList
metadata.description: A new AList Fork to Anti Trust Crisis

summary.zh: OpenList作为AList的抗信任危机分支，遵循AGPL-3.0开源许可，由社区长期治理，提供本地、阿里云盘、OneDrive等多存储统一管理，旨在构建透明、可信的文件管理平台，适用于个人及企业场景。
summary.en: OpenList is a community-driven fork of AList, created to address trust crises in open source projects. It offers a robust platform for managing multiple cloud storage services, such as local storage, Aliyundrive, OneDrive, Google Drive, and others, all under the AGPL-3.0 license. With a focus on transparency, long-term governance, and code openness, OpenList aims to provide a reliable and sustainable solution for file management, suitable for both personal and enterprise use.

metadata.name: yt-dlp
metadata.description: A feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader

summary.zh: yt-dlp是功能强大的命令行音视频下载工具，支持数千网站。它基于youtube-dl分支，提供格式精选、元数据修改、插件扩展及自动化抓取，是多媒体处理的利器。
summary.en: yt-dlp is a feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader supporting thousands of sites, offering advanced format selection, metadata modification, and robust plugin-based automation for media grabbing.

metadata.name: Deadpool
metadata.description: deadpool代理池工具，可从hunter、quake、fofa等网络空间测绘平台取高质量socks5代理，或本地导入socks5代理，轮询使用代理进行流量转发。

summary.zh: Deadpool是一款基于Go语言的代理池工具，能够从Hunter、Quake、Fofa等网络空间测绘平台获取高质量SOCKS5代理，支持本地导入与周期性更新。具备代理健康检查、统计信息展示及优雅关闭功能，通过轮询机制实现流量转发，适用于渗透测试与漏洞扫描等场景。
summary.en: Deadpool is a Go-based proxy pool tool that fetches high-quality SOCKS5 proxies from Hunter, Quake, Fofa, and other cyberspace mapping platforms, with support for local imports and periodic updates. It features proxy health checks, statistics display, and graceful shutdown, using a polling mechanism for traffic forwarding, ideal for penetration testing and vulnerability scanning.

metadata.name: ChinaTextbook
metadata.description: 所有小初高、大学PDF教材。

summary.zh: 本仓库开源了覆盖小初高及大学的完整PDF教材，旨在打破教育资源壁垒、普及义务教育，并助力海外华人子女同步学习国内课程，具有重要的社会公益与文化传承价值。
summary.en: This repository offers a comprehensive, open-source collection of PDF textbooks spanning primary, junior high, senior high, and university levels. The initiative aims to democratize access to quality learning materials, combat the commercial exploitation of proprietary watermarked resources, and support overseas Chinese families in educating their children within the domestic system.

metadata.name: SaveAny-Bot
metadata.description: Save Any Telegram File to Anywhere 📂 (Alist, Disk, Webdav, S3, Rclone...) . Support restrict saving content and files beyond telegram.

summary.zh: 一款强大的 Telegram 文件自动归档机器人，支持突破保存限制，将消息及全网媒体批量同步至 Alist、S3、WebDAV 等云存储，具备自动过滤、多用户管理与高效流式传输能力。
summary.en: SaveAny-Bot is a powerful Telegram bot that bypasses saving restrictions, automatically archiving files, videos, and web media to multi-cloud backends like Alist, S3, and WebDAV, featuring batch downloads, filters, and multi-user support.

metadata.name: PROXY-List
metadata.description: Get PROXY List  that gets updated everyday

summary.zh: 该仓库每日更新数千个免费公共代理（支持SOCKS与HTTP协议），专为开发者和网络爬虫提供便捷的匿名IP资源与高效的代理验证工具，广泛应用于数据采集、网络测试及教育学习场景。
summary.en: This repository provides a comprehensive, daily-updated list of over 9,000 free public proxies, supporting SOCKS5, SOCKS4, and HTTP protocols. It is a valuable resource designed for developers, network researchers, and web scraping practitioners seeking reliable, anonymous IP access. The project simplifies proxy utilization for large-scale data collection, network testing, and educational research, offering auxiliary tools like SOCKER to check proxy health and performance, thereby ensuring a smoother and more efficient workflow for global data acquisition and bypassing network restrictions.

metadata.name: Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller
metadata.description: Remove large amounts of unwanted applications quickly.

summary.zh: BCUninstaller 是一款强大的 Windows 批量软件卸载工具，支持极速清除大量 unwanted 应用程序并彻底清理系统残留，兼容多种安装格式，是系统运维与软件管理的高效利器。
summary.en: Bulk Crap Uninstaller (BCU) is a powerful Windows desktop utility designed for rapidly uninstalling large batches of unwanted applications and thoroughly cleaning system leftovers. Supporting multiple installer formats and detecting orphaned software, it minimizes user input for massive system cleanup, making it an essential tool for IT professionals and advanced users seeking efficient system maintenance and automation.

metadata.name: proxy-scraper
metadata.description: ⭐️ A proxy scraper made using Protractor | Proxy list Updates every three hour 🔥

summary.zh: 基于Protractor实现的自动化代理IP爬虫，支持多协议抓取与定时更新，输出JSON、TXT等多种格式，广泛应用于数据爬取、匿名网络访问及自动化测试中的IP代理池构建。
summary.en: An automated proxy scraper leveraging Protractor and Selenium to efficiently harvest HTTP, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies. It features scheduled updates every few hours and outputs versatile formats like JSON, CSV, and XML, serving as a robust IP pool solution for web scraping, anonymity, and automated testing.

metadata.name: DailyHotApi
metadata.description: 🔥 今日热榜 API，一个聚合热门数据的 API 接口，支持 RSS 模式 及 Vercel 部署 | 前端页面：https://github.com/imsyy/DailyHot

summary.zh: 今日热榜 API 是一个聚合多平台热门数据的接口服务，支持 JSON 和 RSS 两种输出格式，具备极快响应和简易部署（如 Vercel）的特点。它简化了获取各大平台热点数据的流程，适用于需要实时热门信息的开发者与应用场景，助力快速构建数据驱动产品。
summary.en: DailyHot API aggregates trending data from multiple platforms, offering both JSON and RSS formats. With fast response times and easy deployment options like Vercel and Docker, it simplifies access to real-time hot topics. The API features a clean routing structure, making it easy to add new platforms. Developers can quickly integrate popular data into their applications, enabling the creation of data-driven products without complex infrastructure.

metadata.name: lx-music-mobile
metadata.description: 一个基于 React native 开发的音乐软件

summary.zh: LX Music 移动版是一款基于 React Native 和 Redux 构建的开源音乐播放应用，专注于 Android 平台。它整合了多种音乐源，支持自定义源和数据同步，为用户提供灵活的音乐播放体验。项目遵循 Apache License 2.0 许可证。
summary.en: LX Music Mobile is an open-source music player application developed using React Native and Redux, currently supporting Android. It integrates multiple music sources, enables custom source configuration and data synchronization, providing users with a flexible and personalized music playback experience. The project is released under the Apache License 2.0.

metadata.name: lxmusic-
metadata.description: lxmusic(洛雪音乐)全网最新最全音源

summary.zh: 仓库提供适用于洛雪音乐（LX Music）与澜音播放器的最新、最全第三方音源配置与导入链接，涵盖多种音质与付费源服务，旨在帮助用户轻松配置并畅享海量在线音乐资源。
summary.en: Provides the latest and most comprehensive third-party music source configurations and import links for LX Music and Lanyin players, enabling users to easily access and stream massive online music libraries with high audio quality.

metadata.name: breezy-weather
metadata.description: A feature-rich weather app with good visualizations and more than 50 sources.

summary.zh: Breezy Weather 是一个功能丰富的开源 Android 天气应用，支持超过 50 个天气数据源，提供预报、观测、空气质量等全面信息。采用 Kotlin 和 Jetpack Compose 开发，结合 Material 3 Expressive 设计，实现优异的视觉化效果，适合日常天气查询需求。
summary.en: Breezy Weather is a feature-rich, open-source Android weather app supporting over 50 sources, offering forecasts, observations, air quality, and more. Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, it features Material 3 Expressive design for enhanced visualizations, ideal for comprehensive weather data needs.

metadata.name: Douyin_TikTok_Download_API
metadata.description: 🚀 自托管的抖音、TikTok 数据采集与无水印视频下载 API，支持 AI agent 通过 MCP 调用与离线语音转文字，Docker 一键部署。| Self-hosted TikTok & Douyin scraper and no-watermark video downloader — async REST API, MCP server for AI agents, CLI and web console, plus offline speech-to-text for downloaded videos. Self-healing identity pool, PostgreSQL archive, one docker compose up.

summary.zh: 一个自托管的抖音与TikTok无水印视频下载及数据采集API。支持Docker一键部署，集成MCP协议供AI智能体调用，并具备离线语音转文字与PostgreSQL存档功能，适用于自动化数据采集与分析。
summary.en: A self-hosted, powerful API for scraping Douyin and TikTok, enabling watermark-free video downloads and comprehensive data collection. Fully containerized via Docker, it features an MCP server for AI agents, an async REST API, offline speech-to-text, and robust PostgreSQL archiving.

metadata.name: free-nodes
metadata.description: 免费节点订阅：Clash、V2RayN、Shadowrocket｜Base64 与 YAML 每 2 小时更新

summary.zh: 提供兼容Clash、V2RayN与Shadowrocket的免费节点订阅，每两小时自动更新Base64与YAML格式。基于公开源解析及IP地理命名，方便多客户端快速导入，仅提供格式与完整性校验，不承诺节点速度与稳定性。
summary.en: This project offers free proxy node subscriptions tailored for Clash, V2RayN, and Shadowrocket, with Base64 and YAML formats updated every two hours. It automatically scrapes public sources, validates data structure, and labels nodes using geographic flags based on IP resolution. The primary goal is to provide a standardized, easy-to-import configuration list for multiple proxy tools, focusing purely on format integrity rather than performance guarantees.

metadata.name: GitHubDesktop2Chinese
metadata.description: GithubDesktop语言本地化(汉化)工具 【GitHub桌面客户端中文汉化】

summary.zh: GitHubDesktop2Chinese 是一款自动化汉化工具，通过正则匹配替换 GitHub Desktop 客户端中的英文文本为中文，兼容版本频繁更新，维护成本低。支持自动下载映射文件、断点续传、代理设置等功能，适用于中文用户快速汉化 GitHub Desktop 界面。
summary.en: GitHubDesktop2Chinese is an automated localization tool that replaces English text in GitHub Desktop with Chinese via regex matching. It is highly compatible with frequent updates, requires low maintenance, and features automatic mapping file download, resumable transfers, and proxy support. Ideal for Chinese users to localize the GitHub Desktop interface.

metadata.name: HotPEToolBox
metadata.description: 一个纯净、强大、优雅的WinPE

summary.zh: HotPEToolBox 是一个基于 Python 的 WinPE 构建工具，用于生成功能强大的 HotPE 系统。它支持 Win10/11 镜像，提供网络、声音、远程等丰富功能，适用于系统维护和恢复场景。项目开源，遵循 MIT 许可证。
summary.en: HotPEToolBox is a Python-based WinPE build tool for creating the powerful HotPE system. It supports Win10/11 images and offers features like networking, audio, and remote access, suitable for system maintenance and recovery. The project is open-source under the MIT license.

metadata.name: notepad--
metadata.description: 一个支持windows/linux/mac的文本编辑器，目标是做中国人自己的编辑器，来自中国。

summary.zh: Notepad-- 是一款由中国开发者打造的轻量级文本编辑器，致力于实现国产软件可替代，支持 Windows、Linux 和 Mac 多平台。其核心优势在于跨平台兼容性，特别针对国产信创 Uos 系统优化，提供稳定高效的文本编辑体验，是替代传统 Notepad 类软件的理想选择。
summary.en: Notepad-- is a lightweight text editor developed in China, aiming to provide a domestic alternative for text editing software. It supports Windows, Linux, and Mac platforms, with a strong emphasis on cross-platform compatibility and optimization for domestic innovation systems such as Uos. This editor offers a reliable and efficient solution for users seeking a国产替代 option.

metadata.name: BPB-Worker-Panel
metadata.description: A GUI Panel providing Worker subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan and Warp configs alongside a private DoH server and chain proxies, offering full DNS, clean IP,  Fragment, Warp, Warp pro and routing settings for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores.

summary.zh: BPB Worker Panel 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的免费 GUI 面板，提供 VLESS、Trojan、Warp 等多种代理协议及私有 DoH 服务器与链式代理。支持跨平台客户端，具备强大路由规则与自定义功能，助力用户绕过网络限制、保护隐私，实现安全高速访问。
summary.en: BPB Worker Panel is a free GUI panel based on Cloudflare Workers, offering VLESS, Trojan, Warp protocols, private DoH server, and chain proxy. It supports cross-platform clients with robust routing and customization, helping users bypass restrictions, protect privacy, and enjoy secure, fast access.

metadata.name: GoGoGo
metadata.description: 一个基于 Android 调试 API + 百度地图实现的虚拟定位工具，并且同时实现了一个可以自由移动的摇杆

summary.zh: 影梭（GoGoGo）是一款基于 Android 调试 API 和百度地图 SDK 的虚拟定位工具，无需 ROOT 权限，适用于 Android 8.0 及以上版本。它支持自由移动摇杆、历史记录、位置搜索等功能，主要用于学习 Android 开发和地图集成技术。开发者强调其教育用途，警告不要用于游戏或校园运动作弊。
summary.en: YingSuo (GoGoGo) is a virtual positioning tool leveraging Android Debug API and Baidu Map SDK, enabling location modification without ROOT access on Android 8.0+. It features a free-moving joystick, history tracking, and location search, primarily for educational purposes in learning Android development and map integration. The developer warns against misuse for cheating in games or campus sports.

metadata.name: NetMount
metadata.description: 统一管理和挂载云存储设施/Unified management and mounting of cloud storage facilities

summary.zh: NetMount 是一个基于 Rust 和 TypeScript 的跨平台桌面应用，通过 Tauri 框架构建，旨在统一管理和挂载多种云存储设施。它利用 Rclone 和 OpenList 作为依赖框架，简化云存储的配置和使用，适用于需要高效管理多个云存储服务的个人和企业用户。技术栈包括 React 和 Vite，确保高性能和易用性。
summary.en: NetMount is a cross-platform desktop application built with Rust and TypeScript using the Tauri framework. It provides unified management and mounting of various cloud storage facilities, leveraging Rclone and OpenList as dependent frameworks. This simplifies the configuration and usage of cloud storage, making it ideal for personal and enterprise users who need to efficiently handle multiple cloud services. The tech stack includes React and Vite for high performance and usability.

metadata.name: Cloudflare-vless-trojan
metadata.description: CF-workers/pages代理脚本：支持Vless-ws(tls)、Trojan-ws(tls)；Socks5/http本地代理脚本：可选ECH-TLS、普通TLS、无TLS三种代理模式

summary.zh: 本项目提供基于Cloudflare Workers/Pages的代理脚本，支持Vless和Trojan协议，使用WebSocket和TLS加密，无需自定义域名即可快速部署。同时提供本地Socks5/HTTP代理脚本，支持ECH-TLS、普通TLS和无TLS模式。适用于科学上网和网络代理，支持多种客户端订阅格式。
summary.en: This project provides proxy scripts based on Cloudflare Workers/Pages, supporting Vless and Trojan protocols with WebSocket and TLS encryption, allowing quick deployment without custom domains. It also includes local Socks5/HTTP proxy scripts supporting ECH-TLS, regular TLS, and no TLS modes. Suitable for scientific internet access and network proxy, with support for multiple client subscription formats.

metadata.name: ai-goofish-monitor
metadata.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。

summary.zh: 基于 Playwright 和 AI 大模型的闲鱼多任务实时监控与智能分析系统，提供功能完善的 Web 管理界面。支持多账号代理轮换、高级筛选与多渠道即时通知，结合多模态 AI 深度分析商品，助力用户高效淘好物。
summary.en: A robust real-time monitoring and intelligent analysis system for Xianyu, built on Playwright and AI, featuring a comprehensive web management UI. It supports concurrent multi-tasking, multi-account proxy rotation, advanced geographic and price filters, and multi-channel notifications. Utilizing multimodal AI models, it deeply analyzes listings to help users efficiently filter and discover desired products.

metadata.name: taosync
metadata.description: TaoSync是一个适用于OpenList v3+的自动化同步工具/Sync for OpenList/AList

summary.zh: TaoSync是一个基于Python和Vue技术栈的自动化云存储同步工具，专为OpenList v3+设计，内置存储引擎，支持全平台，适用于多场景文件同步备份与定时下载任务。
summary.en: TaoSync is an automated cloud storage synchronization tool built with Python and Vue, designed for seamless integration with OpenList v3+ and above. It features a built-in storage engine, eliminating the need for an external OpenList instance while still allowing additional drivers. The tool supports full synchronization, additive-only sync, and scheduled downloads via cron expressions. Available for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android, TaoSync is a free and open-source solution ideal for backing up files across multiple cloud drives or automating off-peak downloads, ensuring efficient and reliable file management.

metadata.name: HelloGitHub
metadata.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.

summary.zh: HelloGitHub 是一个分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的开源社区项目。它通过月刊形式聚合优质内容，帮助开发者快速发现并体验开源魅力，降低参与门槛，是开源入门与学习的绝佳指南。
summary.en: HelloGitHub is a community project curating interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub. By aggregating quality content into monthly issues, it helps developers quickly discover projects, experience the charm of open source, and lower the barrier to entry for newcomers.

metadata.name: NoMoreWalls
metadata.description: 自动抓取合并互联网上的公开节点。

summary.zh: NoMoreWalls 是一个自动化抓取互联网公开代理节点的工具，通过 GitHub Actions 持续聚合节点并生成 Clash 订阅链接。它提供智能分流规则、自动识别被墙域名及多个 CDN 镜像，旨在为用户提供免费、稳定的科学上网节点，同时内置反 996 许可证，强调遵守劳动法。
summary.en: NoMoreWalls automatically fetches and aggregates public proxy nodes from the internet, generating Clash subscription links via GitHub Actions. It offers intelligent routing rules, DNS anti-poisoning, and multiple CDN mirrors for free, stable internet access. The project includes an anti-996 license, promoting compliance with labor laws.

metadata.name: httpsok
metadata.description: 🔥🔥🔥一行命令，轻松搞定SSL证书自动续期。 SSL泛域名证书，SSL证书管理，SSL证书自动续期，SSL证书自动更新，七牛云、阿里云、腾讯云、CDN、OSS、https证书管理,https证书管理,免费SSL证书,TLS证书自动续签,nginx证书自动续期工具，nginx证书管理。从此告别Let's Encrypt

summary.zh: httpsok是一个高效的SSL证书自动续期工具，通过一行命令即可实现证书的自动更新与管理。支持泛域名、多云厂商及复杂服务器环境，自动检测配置，兼容Nginx、Apache等，提供证书监控提醒，显著降低运维复杂度，保障HTTPS服务安全稳定。
summary.en: httpsok is an efficient tool for automatic SSL certificate renewal, simplifying management with a single command. It supports wildcard certificates, multiple cloud providers, and complex server setups, auto-detecting configurations for Nginx, Apache, etc. Features include monitoring alerts, ensuring secure and stable HTTPS services while reducing operational overhead.

metadata.name: cf-proxy-ex
metadata.description: Cloudflare超级代理，无服务器代理，Duckduckgo代理（可用AI聊天，包含GPT4o/Claude3），Github加速，支持解锁Libgen，在线代理。现已支持多平台部署。Cloudflare super proxy, setting up a free serverless proxy by using Cloudflare worker, support Duckduckgo / Libgen. Now you can deploy this project on different platforms.

summary.zh: Cloudflare Proxy EX 是一款基于 Cloudflare Worker 的免费无服务器代理，支持 Duckduckgo AI 聊天（集成 GPT4o/Claude3）、Github 加速和 Libgen 解锁。技术亮点包括多平台部署、安全密码机制和 Cookie 作用域管理，确保网站访问与原站无异，适用于需要可靠在线代理的场景。
summary.en: Cloudflare Proxy EX is a free serverless proxy built on Cloudflare Worker, providing proxy services for Duckduckgo with AI chat capabilities (including GPT4o/Claude3), Github acceleration, and Libgen unlocking. Key features include multi-platform deployment, security password authentication, and advanced Cookie management, making it ideal for seamless website access.

metadata.name: Nagram
metadata.description: The third-party Telegram android app.

summary.zh: Nagram 是基于 NekoX 的第三方 Telegram 客户端，深度定制了合并消息、撤销重做等个性化功能，并内置强大的代理与多语言翻译服务，旨在提升用户的隐私保护与即时通讯体验。
summary.en: Nagram is a highly customized, third-party Telegram Android client built on NekoX, featuring unique message combining, robust proxy support, multi-language translation, and extensive privacy options, delivering a seamless, secure, and highly personalized messaging experience.

metadata.name: tvbox
metadata.description: OK影视、tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。

summary.zh: qist/tvbox 仓库提供丰富的TVBox配置文件，适用于OK影视、猫影视等应用，帮助用户快速搭建个性化影视服务。配置涵盖多种源和代理选项，支持跨平台部署，简化配置过程，核心价值在于共享影视源资源，提升便捷性与观看体验。
summary.en: The qist/tvbox repository offers a variety of TVBox configuration files for apps like OK影视 and 猫影视, enabling quick setup of customized video streaming services. With multi-source and proxy support, it works across platforms such as TVs and phones, simplifying deployment and promoting resource sharing for enhanced accessibility.

metadata.name: iptv-api
metadata.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署

summary.zh: IPTV-API是一款自动化直播源采集与智能筛选工具，支持多源聚合、测速校验并生成M3U/API等多格式输出。结合CLI、GUI及Docker部署，实现跨平台自定义频道与自动化运维。
summary.en: IPTV-API is a highly efficient, automated solution for collecting, validating, and speed-testing IPTV live stream sources. It supports multi-source aggregation, custom template filtering, IPv4/IPv6, and outputs playlists in M3U, TXT, and API formats. With flexible deployment via CLI, GUI desktop application, and Docker, it provides a robust, cross-platform way to customize channels and automate playlist maintenance, ideal for personal media servers.

metadata.name: awesome-cloudflare
metadata.description: ⛅️ 精选的 Cloudflare 工具、开源项目、指南、博客和其他资源列表。/ ⛅️ A curated list of Cloudflare tools, open source projects, guides, blogs and other resources.

summary.zh: 精选 Cloudflare 生态下的开源工具与资源，覆盖图床、邮箱、博客等多元场景，为独立开发者提供一站式工具集。基于 Cloudflare 的 CDN 与边缘计算技术，简单便捷，有效降低开发成本与时间，助力早期探索。
summary.en: A curated list of Cloudflare-based open source tools and resources, covering image hosting, email, blogs, and more, providing a one-stop toolkit for indie developers. Leveraging Cloudflare's CDN and edge computing technologies, these tools are simple and cost-effective, helping developers reduce costs and time during early-stage exploration.

metadata.name: proxypin
metadata.description: Open source free capture HTTP(S) traffic  software ProxyPin, supporting full platform systems

summary.zh: ProxyPin是一款基于Flutter开发的跨平台开源免费HTTP(S)抓包工具，支持全平台系统。它提供扫码连接、域名过滤、脚本注入、请求重写及AES解密等强大功能，界面精美易用，适用于网络流量捕获、调试与安全分析。
summary.en: ProxyPin is an open-source, free HTTP(S) traffic capture tool built with Flutter, supporting full-platform systems including Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, and Linux. It offers features like scan-to-connect, domain filtering, JavaScript scripting, request rewriting, and AES decryption, providing a beautiful UI for efficient network debugging and security analysis.

metadata.name: ecs
metadata.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs

summary.zh: 该脚本是一个用于 VPS 服务器综合测评的工具，支持多种操作系统和架构，可进行网络速度、IP 质量和路由测试。提供交互式和参数化操作模式，但项目推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本以获得更全面和高效的测试体验。
summary.en: This script is a comprehensive VPS server testing tool that supports multiple operating systems and architectures. It tests network speed, IP quality, and routing paths, with interactive and parameterized modes. The project recommends using the Go version for zero external dependencies and more efficient, comprehensive testing.

metadata.name: GOODBYEADS
metadata.description: 适用于AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS的去广告规则，合并优质上游规则并去重整理排列。

summary.zh: GOODBYEADS是一个强力的去广告规则集合，适用于AdGuard、Quantumult X和SmartDNS等工具。它合并多个优质上游规则，经去重整理提供超21万条拦截规则，包含DNS拦截与白名单。支持定时更新与多格式输出，有效拦截网络广告，提升浏览体验。
summary.en: GOODBYEADS is a powerful ad-blocking rule set for AdGuard, Quantumult X, and SmartDNS. It merges high-quality upstream rules, deduplicates and organizes them, offering over 210,000 blocking rules including DNS blocking and whitelists. With regular updates and multiple format support, it effectively blocks online ads and improves browsing experience.

metadata.name: Sandboxie
metadata.description: Sandboxie Plus & Classic

summary.zh: Sandboxie 是 Windows 沙盒隔离工具，通过虚拟安全环境运行不可信程序，防止对注册表和磁盘的持久修改。支持 Qt 与经典 UI，提供快照管理、便携模式及进程隔离，适用于安全测试和隐私保护。
summary.en: Sandboxie Plus & Classic is a powerful sandbox-based isolation software designed for Windows operating systems. It creates a secure, virtualized environment in which users can run untrusted applications and perform web browsing without permanently altering the local drives or the Windows registry. Offering both a modern Qt-based interface (Plus) and a classic UI, the tool provides robust process isolation, snapshot management, and portable installation options, making it an essential security utility for testing untrusted software safely while isolating programs from the host.

metadata.name: FreeNodes
metadata.description: v2ray、clash免费节点爬虫，自动更新

summary.zh: 该仓库是一个AI驱动的v2ray和Clash免费节点爬虫，每日自动运行更新。核心价值在于自动化收集网络代理节点，适用于科学上网和学习交流。技术亮点包括多目标爬取、支持txt和yaml格式，以及镜像加速功能，确保节点订阅的便捷性和可靠性。
summary.en: The Barabama/FreeNodes repository offers an AI-powered crawler for free v2ray and Clash nodes, with automatic daily updates. It provides automated collection of proxy nodes for internet access and educational purposes. Key features include multi-target scraping, support for txt and yaml formats, and mirror acceleration, ensuring efficient and reliable node subscription management.

metadata.name: N3RD
metadata.description: CTV

summary.zh: CTV 是一款基于 AI 的自动化工具，专为简化复杂工作流程而设计。它利用先进的人工智能技术，自动处理数据密集型任务，适用于企业运维和日常自动化需求。技术上集成大模型和提示工程，确保高效准确的执行，提升整体生产力。
summary.en: CTV is an AI-powered automation tool designed to streamline complex workflows. It leverages advanced AI technologies to automate data-intensive tasks, suitable for enterprise operations and daily automation needs. Technically, it integrates large models and prompt engineering for efficient and accurate execution, enhancing overall productivity.

metadata.name: adblockfilters
metadata.description: 去广告合并规则，每8个小时更新一次。

summary.zh: 本项目定时自动合并、去重并清洗上游广告过滤规则，通过DNS解析剔除失效域名。生成适配AdGuard、DNSMasq等跨平台的拦截规则，提升广告拦截效率与设备防护能力。
summary.en: Automatically merges and deduplicates ad-block filters from upstream sources, pruning invalid domains via DNS resolution. Generates optimized, multi-platform rule lists for AdGuard, DNSMasq, and browser extensions, ensuring lightweight and highly effective ad-blocking.

metadata.name: x-ui-yg
metadata.description: x-ui精简修改版脚本，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp传输协议、ENC加密、MLDSA65加密，集成argo固定临时双隧道（可共存）、Psiphon赛风VPN（30个国家）分流功能，支持部分节点聚合订阅、sing-box订阅、clash-meta订阅的配置输出

summary.zh: x-ui精简修改版一键脚本，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp协议及ENC/MLDSA65加密，集成Argo双隧道和Psiphon VPN分流，提供本地化节点生成与多格式订阅输出，适用于多系统VPS快速部署高性能代理服务。
summary.en: A streamlined x-ui modification script supporting Hysteria2, Xhttp, and ENC/MLDSA65 encryption, with integrated Argo tunnels and Psiphon VPN diversion, offering local node generation and multi-format subscription output for quick proxy deployment on various VPS systems.

metadata.name: TikTokDownloader
metadata.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具

summary.zh: DouK-Downloader 是一款功能全面的抖音/TikTok 数据采集与下载工具，支持批量获取视频、图集、直播流及账号作品，具备最高画质下载、数据持久化、多线程下载、Web UI 与 API 交互、代理网络等特性，适用于内容创作者、研究者及自动化数据采集场景。
summary.en: DouK-Downloader is a comprehensive TikTok/Douyin data scraping and downloading tool, supporting batch acquisition of videos, images, live streams, and account works. It features max quality download, data persistence, multi-threading, Web UI & API, and proxy support, ideal for creators, researchers, and automated data collection.

metadata.name: mediago
metadata.description: Cross-platform video downloader — sniff and grab m3u8/HLS streams, Bilibili, YouTube and more. Desktop + Docker + 🦞.

summary.zh: MediaGo是一款功能强大的跨平台视频下载工具，内置流媒体嗅探技术，支持YouTube、Bilibili等千余站点。结合桌面应用、浏览器插件及Docker部署，并集成AI智能体交互，实现一键自动化高清视频抓取与格式转换。
summary.en: MediaGo is a powerful cross-platform video downloader featuring built-in stream sniffing for 1000+ sites like YouTube and Bilibili. It integrates desktop, browser extension, Docker, and AI assistant support, offering automated downloading, format conversion, and API control.

metadata.name: SmartTube
metadata.description: Browse media content with your own rules on Android TV

summary.zh: SmartTube 是一款专为 Android TV 设计的免费开源媒体客户端，支持用户自定义规则浏览和播放多种公共媒体源。其亮点包括 TV 优化界面、8K 分辨率、60fps 播放、HDR 兼容及 SponsorBlock 集成，无需 Google 服务即可运行，适用于 Android TV 和电视盒子。
summary.en: SmartTube is a free and open-source media client for Android TV, allowing users to browse media content with custom rules. It features a TV-optimized interface, 8K resolution, 60fps playback, HDR support, and SponsorBlock integration. It runs without Google Services and is compatible with Android TVs and TV boxes.

summary.zh: leiurayer/downkyi 仓库原本是一个哔哩哔哩视频下载工具，核心价值在于通过逆向分析实现平台视频下载，包括突破付费内容保护。应用场景主要面向用户离线观看或存档需求。技术亮点包括绕过认证体系和反爬风控，抓取高清视频及弹幕字幕。目前因侵权指控已停止维护。
summary.en: The leiurayer/downkyi repository was originally a Bilibili video downloader, with core value in enabling platform video downloads through reverse engineering, including bypassing paid content protection. The primary application scenario is for offline viewing or archiving. Technical highlights include bypassing authentication and anti-scraping measures to capture high-quality videos and subtitles. It has been discontinued due to infringement allegations.

metadata.name: biliup
metadata.description: 自动直播录制、投稿、twitch、ytb频道搬运工具。命令行投稿(B站)和视频下载工具，提供多种登录方式，支持多p。边录边传0落盘

summary.zh: biliup 是一款功能强大的自动化直播录制与投稿工具，支持 B 站、Twitch、YouTube 等 19 个平台，具备边录边传、弹幕抓取、多机录制、WebUI 预览等特色，适用于个人主播和团队无人值守的直播内容搬运与管理。
summary.en: biliup is an automated live stream recording and uploading tool that supports 19 platforms including Bilibili, Twitch, and YouTube. It features zero-disk-buffering recording, danmaku capture, multi-device recording, and WebUI preview, suitable for individual creators and teams needing unmanned content repurposing and management.

metadata.name: rsspush
metadata.description: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。

summary.zh: RSSPush 是一款基于 Docker 的 Web 应用，自动监测 RSS 源变动并实时推送至微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十个消息通道。集成 RSSHub 提供两千多种源，支持 HTTP 代理、黑白名单过滤与 AI 自动翻译，适用于个人与团队构建高效信息自动化推送流水线。
summary.en: RSSPush is a Docker-based Web app that monitors RSS feeds and pushes updates to dozens of messaging channels like WeChat, Telegram, and Discord. It integrates RSSHub for over 2,000 sources, supports HTTP proxy, keyword filtering, and AI translation, making it ideal for automated content distribution.

metadata.name: anti-AD
metadata.description: 致力于成为中文区命中率最高的广告过滤列表，实现精确的广告屏蔽和隐私保护。anti-AD 现已支持 AdGuardHome，dnsmasq，Surge，Pi-Hole，Clash, mihomo，smartdns，sing-box 等网络组件。完全兼容常见的广告过滤工具所支持的各种广告过滤列表格式

summary.zh: anti-AD项目专注于中文区，提供高命中率的广告过滤列表，通过域名解析层合并优化多个来源，实现精确广告屏蔽和隐私保护。支持AdGuardHome、dnsmasq、Surge等网络组件，技术亮点包括抽象化处理和增强黑白名单机制，有效屏蔽广告及隐私泄露站点。
summary.en: anti-AD is a project focused on the Chinese region, offering high hit rate ad filtering lists by merging and optimizing multiple sources at the DNS resolution layer. It enables precise ad blocking and privacy protection, supporting network components like AdGuardHome, dnsmasq, Surge. Key features include abstraction techniques and enhanced blacklist mechanisms to block ads and privacy-tracking sites.

metadata.name: changedetection.io
metadata.description: Best and simplest tool for website change detection, web page monitoring, and website change alerts. Perfect for tracking content changes, price drops, restock alerts, and website defacement monitoring—all for free or enjoy our SaaS plan!

summary.zh: 这款强大且极简的网站内容变化检测与监控工具，支持实时价格追踪、内容更新和库存提醒。集成AI大模型，提供智能噪音过滤与自然语言变更摘要，支持Discord、Slack等多种通知渠道，助力高效自动化监控。
summary.en: The simplest and most powerful website change detection tool, offering real-time monitoring for price drops, restocks, and content edits. Powered by AI, it filters noise and provides plain-language summaries, sending instant alerts via Discord, Slack, Telegram, and email.

metadata.name: Docker_Microsoft365_E5_Renew_X
metadata.description: Docker版本的E5调用API续订服务：Microsoft 365 E5 Renew X

summary.zh: 本项目通过Docker容器化技术实现Microsoft 365 E5 Renew X服务的便捷部署，支持多CPU架构，具有镜像体积小、部署命令简单、邮件通知等特性，适用于需要自动化续订E5订阅的场景，适合学习和非商业用途。
summary.en: This project leverages Docker containerization to provide a convenient deployment of the Microsoft 365 E5 Renew X service, supporting multiple CPU architectures. It features a small image size, simple deployment commands, and email notifications, making it suitable for scenarios requiring automated E5 subscription renewal, intended for learning and non-commercial use.

metadata.name: FileCentipede
metadata.description: Cross-platform internet upload/download manager for HTTP(S), FTP(S), SSH, magnet-link, BitTorrent, m3u8, ed2k, and online videos.  WebDAV client, FTP client, SSH client.

summary.zh: FileCentipede 是一款跨平台多协议全能下载与文件管理工具，支持HTTP、BT、FTP、SSH、WebDAV等协议。集成浏览器插件可提取网页音视频，辅以文件合并、编码、创建种子等工具，实现一站式高效资源抓取与管理。
summary.en: FileCentipede is a cross-platform, multi-protocol all-in-one file download and management tool supporting HTTP(S), BitTorrent, FTP(S), SSH, WebDAV, and magnet links. It features a browser extension to extract online videos and audio, alongside utility tools for file merging, encoding, and torrent creation, offering a unified solution for complex downloads.

metadata.name: v2ray-heroku
metadata.description: 用于在 Heroku 上部署 V2Ray WebSocket。

summary.zh: 本项目实现在Heroku平台快速部署V2Ray WebSocket服务，通过自动化更新确保始终运行最新版本。合理使用可避免资源滥用封号，集成CloudFlare提升访问速度，适用于需要稳定代理服务的场景。
summary.en: This project enables rapid deployment of V2Ray WebSocket on Heroku with automatic version updates. Responsible usage prevents account suspension, while CloudFlare integration enhances speed, ideal for reliable proxy service scenarios.

metadata.name: TrackersListCollection
metadata.description: 🎈 Updated daily! A list of popular BitTorrent Trackers! / 每天更新！全网热门 BT Tracker 列表！

summary.zh: 本仓库每日更新全网热门且精心筛选的BitTorrent Tracker列表，提供多格式与多CDN镜像支持，旨在有效解决BT下载中的连接难题，显著提升下载速度与稳定性，是高效下载的实用工具。
summary.en: This repository features a daily-updated list of highly popular and carefully curated BitTorrent trackers, providing multiple formats and fast global CDN mirrors. It is designed to effectively resolve peer connection issues during BT downloads, significantly boosting transfer speed and stability, making it an essential and highly practical utility for seamless P2P file sharing.

metadata.name: ContextMenuManager
metadata.description: 🖱️ 纯粹的Windows右键菜单管理程序

summary.zh: ContextMenuManager 是一款纯粹的 Windows 右键菜单管理桌面程序，核心功能包括启用、禁用或修改文件、文件夹等场景的右键菜单项，支持自定义添加项目与注册表导航。基于 .NET Framework 开发，兼容 Windows 7 至 10 系统，适用于系统定制与优化，提供高分屏支持。
summary.en: ContextMenuManager is a dedicated Windows context menu management desktop application, enabling users to enable, disable, or modify context menu items for files, folders, and other scenarios. It supports custom item addition and registry navigation, built on .NET Framework with compatibility for Windows 7 to 10, ideal for system customization and optimization.

metadata.name: ShareX
metadata.description: ShareX is a free and open-source application that enables users to capture or record any area of their screen with a single keystroke. It also supports uploading images, text, and various file types to a wide range of destinations.

summary.zh: ShareX是一款免费开源的极致屏幕捕获与文件共享工具，集截图、录屏、图像编辑、OCR识别及高度自定义的自动化工作流于一体。通过热键一键完成捕获、编辑、上传与分享，显著提升个人与团队生产力。
summary.en: ShareX is a powerful, free, and open-source screen capture and file sharing application. It integrates screenshot capture, screen recording, image editing, OCR, and highly customizable automation workflows, allowing users to capture, edit, and share files seamlessly via hotkeys.

metadata.name: WebMonitor
metadata.description: 实时监控网页变化，并发送通知（Monitor web page changes in real time and send notifications）

summary.zh: WebMonitor是一款实时网页监控工具，支持动态页面抓取与多重数据提取。它集成微信、Telegram等丰富通知渠道，提供可视化操作，适用于信息追踪与自动化提醒。
summary.en: WebMonitor is a real-time web monitoring tool that supports dynamic page scraping and flexible data extraction. It integrates rich notification channels like WeChat and Telegram, providing visual operations for info tracking and automated alerts.

metadata.name: v2rayN
metadata.description: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others

summary.zh: v2rayN 是一款跨平台图形界面代理客户端，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。它集成 Xray、sing-box 等多种代理核心，提供直观的配置与规则管理，适用于科学上网和网络流量过滤。发布文件经 GPG 签名，确保安全可信。
summary.en: v2rayN is a cross-platform GUI proxy client for Windows, Linux, and macOS. It supports multiple cores like Xray and sing-box, offering intuitive configuration and rule management for circumvention and traffic filtering. Releases are GPG-signed for authenticity and integrity.

metadata.name: ChromeAppHeroes
metadata.description: 🌈谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜, 为优秀的Chrome插件写一本中文说明书, 让Chrome插件英雄们造福人类~  ChromePluginHeroes, Write a Chinese manual for the excellent Chrome plugin, let the Chrome plugin heroes benefit the human~ 公众号「0加1」同步更新

summary.zh: 谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜是一个开源项目，核心价值在于为优秀的Chrome插件提供详尽的中文说明书，帮助中文用户高效发现和使用工具。应用场景覆盖教育、办公和娱乐等领域，技术亮点包括使用docsify构建响应式文档，并托管于GitHub Pages实现跨平台访问，促进知识共享与插件普及。
summary.en: ChromeAppHeroes is an open-source project dedicated to creating comprehensive Chinese manuals for excellent Chrome extensions, aiding Chinese users in discovery and utilization. It applies to education, productivity, and entertainment, with technical highlights like docsify-based documentation and GitHub Pages hosting for cross-platform access, fostering knowledge sharing.

metadata.name: free-api
metadata.description: 收集免费的接口服务,做一个api的搬运工

summary.zh: 本项目收集并整理大量免费 API 接口，覆盖生活、娱乐、AI、安全等多个领域，提供统一文档和在线调用地址，帮助开发者快速集成所需服务，降低开发成本与时间，适合个人及企业项目使用。
summary.en: This project collects and organizes a wide range of free APIs covering various domains such as lifestyle, entertainment, AI, and security. It provides unified documentation and online testing endpoints, enabling developers to quickly integrate services, reduce development costs and time, suitable for personal and corporate projects.
